correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 68–108: merging unspecified Dirichlet coordinates gives u,v_r,w_r; the same-color indicator product vanishes, so the cross moment is m(m−1)w_r. After division by positive factors the sign compares R with m/(m−1). In k=n−r, the factor (a)_k/(b)_k decreases strictly since a=(m−2)α<b=(m−1)α. At r=1, increasing n from 1 multiplies R by 1−α(α+1)/[(b+n)(b+n−1)]<1; at r=n the product starts with m/(m−1) and has further factors greater than one. At α=1 the two marginal ratios give the exact sign of m(r−1)−2(n−1). Independent replay: start with probability 1 on the all-zero count vector, and at step t add color i with weight (α+N_i)/(mα+t); sum the three moments over the final state probabilities. Exact rational replay agrees with the formula and signs in all 420 cases m=3,4,5; n=2,…,8; α=1/2,1,3/2,2; 1≤r≤n, including the exact zero at (3,4,3,1). The reviewed frozen checker is finite, and its numeric checks do not prove asymptotic convergence. Lines 110–133: gamma ratios give R→B/(1−x)^α for r/n→x<1, so test points strictly bracketing the continuous crossing bound the discrete first nonnegative index. Log-convexity puts B in (0,1); Stirling gives (6). For fixed n the iid limit of R never equals m/(m−1): the equality would give (m/(m−1))^(n−1)=((m−1)/(m−2))^(n−r), impossible by taking the valuation of a prime dividing m−1. Thus the discrete index stabilizes as α→∞ at fixed n. Solving the iid logarithmic inequality yields (7). The m=3 fractions already disprove commutation; in fact the fixed-α-first limit is smaller for every m≥3. To verify the strict comparison, put x=1/(m−1), S=atanh(x), T=−log(1−x²)/2. The negative logarithm of the ratio subtracted from 1 in (6) is 2(S−T/x), while that for (7) is 2 atanh(T/S). Put U=S/x and W=T/x². The coefficient of x^(2j) in W(U+1)−U² is (1−B_j)/(2j+2), where B_j=∑_{i=0}^j 1/[(2i+1)(2i+2)]+H_(2j+2)/(2j+3) and H_k is the harmonic number. This follows by multiplying the logarithmic series and splitting the two reciprocal factors. B_0=1 and B_(j+1)−B_j=(3−2H_k)/[(k+1)(k+3)]≤0 for k=2j+2, so T/S≥S−T/x; strict atanh(T/S)>T/S gives the comparison. Neither limit covers a general joint α,n scaling.
